pages.title: Tools
pages.text: Hexalia introduces specialized tools used for rituals, gathering, and utility. Each serves a distinct purpose, often interacting directly with the natural and magical systems of the world.

pages.title: Hex Focus
pages.text: The Hex Focus activates a prepared Ritual Table for Nature Rituals, Summoning, and Celestial Rituals. It also awakens certain enchanted plants and transforms Deepslate into a Ritual Table.

pages.title: Athame
pages.text: An Athame extracts Tree Resin, harvests Lotus Blossoms, and shapes planks into a $(l:hexalia:blocks/ritual_brazier)Ritual Brazier$(/l) while crouching. Defeat a nearby living creature with it to provide the soul awaited by certain $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual#sacrifice)Summonings$(/l).

pages.title: Briar Sickle
pages.text: A harvesting tool designed for clearing vegetation. It cuts through plants in a wide area and can be used with care to gather resources directly from blocks.

pages.title: Rootshaper
pages.text: A shifting tool that adapts to the material being mined. It functions as both a pickaxe and shovel, and can expand its reach to affect a wider area when used with intent.

pages.title: Spiritroot Tether
pages.text: Right-click a compatible creature with an empty Tether to capture it. Right-click a block to release it there. Crouch and right-click a Spirit Bloom with an empty Tether to bind a return point; with a creature stored, crouch and right-click a block to send it to that point.

pages.title: Ladle
pages.text: A simple but essential tool used in $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/brewing)Brewing$(/l). It is required to stir mixtures within the Small Cauldron and begin the cooking process.

pages.title: Sage Pendant
pages.text: Worn or held in the off hand, the Sage Pendant stores bonus XP equal to 25% of the XP you gain, up to 300 XP points. Crouch and right-click once to release the stored XP gradually; wait briefly before activating it again.

pages.title: Heartseed
pages.text: Offer this rare seed to an untamed tameable animal to bind its trust to you at once. The seed is consumed when the bond takes root.
